Context: 11. T.A. on Retirement

## 11. T.A. on Retirement  
[ Swamy's -  
FR & SR, Part-II ]  
1. Entitlements.When the retired employee settles down in a station other than the last station of duty.Same as on transfer including lumpsum Composite Transfer Grant. Travel by air is also admissible.  
The retired employee and family may travel from the last headquarters to the declared Home town, or to any other selected place of residence where he wishes to settle. - GIO (1), SR 147.
